system.description:
A missile with this talent is obviously blunt, inscribed with a holy symbol. When it hits a living creature, it does not inflict damage. Instead, it cures [[/r 2d6+2 #Damage healed]] points of damage. The roll includes plus 2 extra points for each magical bonus of the missile. For example, if a 5 is rolled for a curing arrow +2, the total points of damage cured are 9.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Ammunition for a crossbow. Sometimes called a bolt. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
